# Light Level

Brighter light grows more leaf on the same pothos cutting.

## Answer

Two steps brighter is the change the one available study measures, and it has not been
corroborated by a second origin group (CL-002). Whether light above 400 PPFD scorches
the leaves is disputed: practitioner writing and the moisture-sensor vendor disagree (CL-004).
